title: 布莱克马什·基恩布鲁克剧集回应
instruction:
您是达马里斯·阿尔梅达 (Damaris Almeida)，布莱克马什地区办事处的电影和视频编辑，您确认了 Kilnbrook Freight 信中提到的这一集的出版主控。佩特拉·哈夫利切克 (Petra Havlicek) 要求您准备响应包，因为该指控涉及已发布的主文件中实际存在的内容，而不仅仅是早期工作箱中出现的内容。一旦 Petra 确认其事实陈述和和解条款与已提供的授权相符，Callum Demirci 将原样发送您的信件。 Kilnbrook 的 `Kilnbrook_claim_letter.docx` 确定了剧集、声称的镜头间隔、声称的总持续时间、声称适用的权利立场、请求的金额以及响应截止日期。生产记录在`Blackmarsh_episode_provenance.xlsx`；它们包含鲁本·莫滕森和奥迪尔·达尔加德通过出版记录的开场片段状态以及随后的编辑、替换、修剪和版权事件。这些记录还包括在显示的状态或源描述需要更正时所做的工作注释，因此请像编辑者一样阅读记录，而不是将每个可见的主字段标签视为最后一个词。佩特拉经批准的法律和商业边界位于`Petra_response_authority.docx`。
该文件是许可位置、§107 下的短期报价处理、结算金额和机制、允许的处置语言以及任何释放或保留权利的范围的唯一权威。不要扩大或软化这些立场，提供替代方案，推测附件中未包含的事实，或向佩特拉或卡勒姆提出建议。我需要一封保存为 `Kilnbrook_episode_response.docx` 的可发送回复信和保存为 `Kilnbrook_provenance_annex.xlsx` 的支持出处附件。将这两个文件写入您启动的工作目录的顶层，并使用这些文件名。按照声明的指示写信，并足够准确地识别声明和情节，以免误认为是对不同作品的回应。该信函应确认所声称的持续时间，说明 Blackmarsh 在检查已发布的母版后可以适当承认的材料的持续时间和身份，保留 Petra 授权中确定的协议所涵盖的镜头的许可位置，保留简短报价的授权 §107 位置，并区分作为 Blackmarsh 重新拍摄或公共领域材料支持的镜头。
它应该简明地解释经核实的发表立场与 Kilnbrook 的叙述不同的实质性原因，而无需重述整个编辑历史。包括完全按照授权的结算条款、受理时间、支付机制、发布范围、预订语言和响应渠道。目的是对这一集的主张进行狭隘的解决，而不是与更广泛的制作库进行通信。如果普通的商务格式允许，请将信函保留为两页纸，使用冷静而精确的专业语气，并准备好等待卡勒姆签名，而不是将其写为内部笔记或分析。附件是佩特拉对这封信的可追溯的事实支持。它应涵盖索赔中列出的每个镜头间隔，并以律师可以过滤和验证的形式显示索赔片段标识符、Kilnbrook 声称的间隔和持续时间、相应的最终发布的时间码和持续时间、最终来源或出处类别、适用的权利基础、使用 Petra 批准的词汇的最终处理以及支持的制作记录或事件参考。如果断言的区间解析为多个来源结果，则使该划分可见，而不是将整个区间分配给占用最多时间的类别。
包括一个紧凑的摘要，将 Kilnbrook 声称的总数与已确认的已发布总数进行比较，包括承认的预览材料、许可材料、§107 引用、Blackmarsh 重新拍摄和公共领域材料，并确定声明快照和最终发布状态之间的材料变化。在工作簿中添加简短的方法注释，使您对生产记录的日期显示和任何纠正的每个条目注释的处理足够清晰，以便 Petra 重现结果。工作簿不应再现恰好显示在生产记录附近的不相关操作信息。信函和附件必须就它们共享的每个期限、类别总数、部分处置、协议参考和结算数字达成一致。不要以改变规定总数的方式对素材进行四舍五入；使用一致的时间基础，从各个时间间隔到总结都可以遵循。两个文件都必须干净、可读，无需普通文字处理程序或电子表格应用程序之外的专业软件，并且没有起草注释、未解决的占位符、公式错误、隐藏断言或不受支持的法律和事实主张。 Petra 需要在周五之前准备好完整的文件，以便她可以在 Callum 发送响应之前执行最终的特权和权限检查。

---

上述文件位于`references/`中：
- `references/Kilnbrook_claim_letter.docx` — Kilnbrook Freight 的索赔信，其中标明了该事件、索赔的镜头间隔、声称的持续时间、请求的金额、索赔参考号、收件人和回复截止日期。
- `references/Blackmarsh_episode_provenance.xlsx` — Blackmarsh 地区办公室通过已发布母版的开场片段清单和按时间顺序排列的制作事件，包括来源、时间码、持续时间和纠正制作说明。
- `references/Petra_response_authority.docx` — Petra Havlicek 批准的本集响应的事实、法律、词汇、和解、发布和签名参数。

将您完成的工作写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，使用以下文件名：

- `Kilnbrook_episode_response.docx` — 一封可发送的回复信，解决所提供权限内已识别的事件索赔。 （放置在工作目录的顶层。使用普通的商业信函格式，在普通格式允许的情况下保留两页，并准备好信件供 Callum Demirci 签名。）
- `Kilnbrook_provenance_annex.xlsx` — 可过滤的出处附件，跟踪每个声称的镜头间隔到其经过验证的最终发布状态并总结比较。 （放置在工作目录的顶层。包括请求的区间级字段、类别摘要、比较和可重现的方法注释；排除不相关的操作信息。）

除了这些文件名之外，不会收集任何内容。在其他地方或以任何其他名称编写的正确文件得分为零。

materials.text:
BLACKMARSH REGIONAL OFFICE — RESPONSE AUTHORITY
To: Damaris Almeida, Editor
From: Petra Havlicek, Legal & Business Affairs
Date: 21 August 2026
Matter: KIL-2026-014 / BRO-07 “Night Freight: Kilnbrook Junction”
Approved factual and rights position
For the episode and claim identified above only, state that the published master contains 8.00 seconds of unlicensed Kilnbrook preview material that Blackmarsh can properly concede. Footage under Licence Agreement LIC-KF-2047 is licensed to Blackmarsh for editorial use in the BRO-07 episode, worldwide, for the agreement term through 31 December 2028. The letter may identify 32.00 seconds as licensed footage under that agreement.
The 6.00-second quotation at 00:15:06–00:15:12 (claim segment KF-03) is maintained as a §107 position, not a concession. The approved position is that it is used for criticism and reporting in a transformative episode context; only the amount reasonably necessary to identify the speaker’s point is used; and the use is not a substitute for Kilnbrook’s footage or shown to have a material adverse effect on a cognizable market for the original clip.
The 15.00 seconds at 00:20:00–00:20:15 are Blackmarsh reshoots recorded for this episode. The 14.00 seconds at 00:10:08–00:10:12 and 00:25:00–00:25:10 are public-domain material from the Port Authority Moving Image Archive (PAMIA-1936-11), as corrected in the production record.
Controlled disposition vocabulary for the annex: Conceded preview material; Licensed use — LIC-KF-2047; §107 position — quotation; Blackmarsh reshoot; Public-domain material — PAMIA-1936-11.
Settlement authority
Offer £6,250 inclusive of any interest and costs, in full and final settlement of Kilnbrook’s claim KIL-2026-014 concerning BRO-07 only. The offer must be accepted by email to Petra Havlicek at petra.havlicek@blackmarshregional.example no later than 17:00 BST on 4 September 2026. Payment will be made by bank transfer within 14 days after receipt of a countersigned settlement agreement and valid invoice.
Settlement is without admission of liability except for the expressly conceded 8.00 seconds. Upon cleared payment, Kilnbrook releases Blackmarsh Regional Office and its production partners from this claim and this episode only; no release is offered for any other episode, production, or library material. Blackmarsh reserves all rights, remedies, and defenses not expressly resolved by that episode-specific settlement.
The response should be sent by email to legal@kilnbrookfreight.example, with a copy to Petra. Callum Demirci may sign the external letter. Do not expand these positions to any other production.

Re: Claim KIL-2026-014 — “Night Freight: Kilnbrook Junction” (episode BRO-07)
Dear Ms Sokolov,
We respond to your letter dated 18 August 2026 concerning the published Blackmarsh Regional Office episode “Night Freight: Kilnbrook Junction” (BRO-07). We acknowledge your asserted aggregate of 75.00 seconds across claim segments KF-01 to KF-05.
Our review of the published master verifies 75.00 seconds across those same intervals. Blackmarsh can properly concede 8.00 seconds of unlicensed Kilnbrook preview material: KF-01, 00:10:00–00:10:08. The remaining material is not conceded as unlicensed Kilnbrook footage: 32.00 seconds (KF-02, 00:12:00–00:12:20, and KF-03, 00:15:00–00:15:06 and 00:15:12–00:15:18) is covered by Licence Agreement LIC-KF-2047 for editorial use in BRO-07, worldwide, during its term through 31 December 2028.
The 6.00-second quotation at 00:15:06–00:15:12 in KF-03 remains our authorized §107 position, not a concession. It is used for criticism and reporting in a transformative episode context; only the amount reasonably necessary to identify the speaker’s point is used; and it is not a substitute for Kilnbrook’s footage or shown to have a material adverse effect on a cognizable market for the original clip. The 15.00 seconds in KF-04 (00:20:00–00:20:15) are Blackmarsh reshoots recorded for this episode. The 14.00 seconds in KF-01 (00:10:08–00:10:12) and KF-05 (00:25:00–00:25:10) are public-domain material from the Port Authority Moving Image Archive (PAMIA-1936-11).
The differences from the claim snapshot result from the final editorial changes: KF-01 includes a recorded provenance correction; KF-02 was trimmed to 00:12:20 and its licence reference corrected; KF-03 was split to identify the designated quotation; KF-04 was replaced by a Blackmarsh reshoot; and KF-05 was corrected to the PAMIA-1936-11 source. The enclosed annex provides the interval crosswalk and event references.
Without admission of liability except for the expressly conceded 8.00 seconds, Blackmarsh offers £6,250 inclusive of any interest and costs, in full and final settlement of claim KIL-2026-014 concerning BRO-07 only. Acceptance must be by email to Petra Havlicek at petra.havlicek@blackmarshregional.example no later than 17:00 BST on 4 September 2026. Payment will be made by bank transfer within 14 days after receipt of a countersigned settlement agreement and valid invoice.
Upon cleared payment, Kilnbrook will release Blackmarsh Regional Office and its production partners from this claim and this episode only. No release is offered for any other episode, production, or library material. Blackmarsh reserves all rights, remedies, and defenses not expressly resolved by that episode-specific settlement.
Please send any acceptance to legal@kilnbrookfreight.example, with a copy to Petra. This response is limited to the claim and episode identified above.
Yours faithfully,

Callum Demirci
For Blackmarsh Regional Office

criteria.grader_hint: 确认报价不计入让步间隔或让步持续时间。

original.criterion: The §107 quotation is maintained as a disputed, authorized position rather than included in the conceded preview category.
original.grader_hint: Confirm the quotation is not counted among conceded intervals or conceded duration.

criteria.description: 信中确定的公共领域区间等于其最终出处记录支持该类别的区间。
criteria.evidence: 信件和重播得出的最终状态

criteria.description: 信中所述的公共领域基础与每个此类间隔提供的出处机构或记录相匹配。
criteria.evidence: 信函、出处工作簿和授权文件
criteria.grader_hint: 验证每个依据或来源参考；不接受通用的不受支持的公共领域断言。

original.criterion: The public-domain basis stated in the letter matches the supplied provenance authority or record for each such interval.
original.evidence: Letter, provenance workbook, and authority document
original.grader_hint: Verify each basis or source reference; do not accept a generic unsupported public-domain assertion.

criteria.description: 信中确定的 Blackmarsh 重拍间隔等于 Blackmarsh 发起的重拍支持的最终发布间隔。

criteria.description: 这封信中重新拍摄的事实依据与所提供的制作记录相符，并且没有声称不受支持的作者身份详细信息。

criteria.description: 这封信简明地解释了 Kilnbrook 声称的快照与已验证的已发布状态之间的实质性差异，重点关注实际的替换、修剪或出处更正，而不是叙述无关紧要的日志历史。

original.criterion: The letter concisely explains the material differences between Kilnbrook’s asserted snapshot and the verified published state, focusing on actual replacements, trims, or provenance corrections rather than narrating immaterial log history.
original.grader_hint: A reviewer should be able to understand why the totals or categories differ without reading every event; all stated causes must be traceable.

criteria.description: 信函中的结算金额与Petra的授权金额完全一致，误差为±$0.01。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较金额、货币以及是否包含或不包含任何规定的组成部分。

original.criterion: The settlement amount in the letter exactly matches Petra’s authorized amount, with tolerance ±$0.01.
original.grader_hint: Compare the amount, currency, and whether it is inclusive or exclusive of any stated component.

criteria.description: 信函中的要约到期日期和时间与授权接受截止日期一致。
criteria.grader_hint: 比较提供的日期、时间和时区。

original.criterion: The offer-expiry date and time in the letter match the authorized acceptance deadline.
original.grader_hint: Compare date, time, and time zone where supplied.

criteria.description: 信函准确载明了授权受理方式和回复渠道。

original.criterion: The letter states the authorized acceptance method and response channel accurately.

criteria.description: 信中的付款时间和触发条件与批准的结算机制完全一致。
criteria.grader_hint: 验证时间段及其运行的事件。

original.criterion: The payment timing and triggering condition in the letter exactly match the approved settlement mechanics.
original.grader_hint: Verify both the time period and the event from which it runs.

criteria.description: 释放和和解处置语言与 Petra 批准的针对已确定索赔和事件的表述相符。

original.criterion: The release and settlement disposition language matches Petra’s approved formulation for the identified claim and episode.
original.grader_hint: Confirm that the release conditions, covered claim, and effective trigger are all present and not rewritten materially.

criteria.description: 禁止入场的语言与所提供的权威相匹配，同时与信中明确的让步保持一致。
criteria.grader_hint: 该信函不得使用与其让步相矛盾的全面否认或比授权更广泛的承认。

original.criterion: The no-admission language matches the supplied authority while remaining consistent with the letter’s express concessions.
original.grader_hint: The letter must not use a blanket denial that contradicts its concessions or a broader admission than authorized.

criteria.description: 存在保留权利的语言，并且不超出或淡化所提供的权限。
criteria.grader_hint: 将保留的权利和辩护与佩特拉批准的措辞进行比较。

original.criterion: The reservation-of-rights language is present and does not exceed or dilute the supplied authority.
original.grader_hint: Compare the retained rights and defenses with Petra’s approved wording.

criteria.description: 这封信已准备好发送：冷静、准确、非指责性、内部连贯，并且以外部信件而非内部建议或法律备忘录的形式撰写。

original.criterion: The letter is send-ready: calm, precise, non-accusatory, internally coherent, and written as external correspondence rather than an internal recommendation or legal memorandum.

criteria.description: 渲染的信件适合两页，使用清晰的普通商业格式，没有剪裁、重叠文本或人为压缩的类型。
criteria.grader_hint: 渲染为 PDF 或在标准文字处理器中检查；拒绝细小的字体、极端的边距、剪裁的文本或溢出到第三页。

original.grader_hint: Render to PDF or inspect in a standard word processor; reject tiny type, extreme margins, clipped text, or spill onto a third page.

criteria.description: 每个声明的镜头间隔都在附件中完整表示，并带有拆分行，其中一个声明的间隔解析为多个最终出处结果。

spec.professional_context: Damaris Almeida is the editor responsible for reconstructing the provenance of footage used in one published Blackmarsh Regional Office episode. Petra Havlicek needs a factually controlled response package for Kilnbrook Freight that Callum Demirci can send without revision.
difficulty_sources: Replaying ordered edit and provenance events to reconstruct the final published state
Splitting claimed footage intervals where final provenance changes
Recognizing explicit corrections in free-text production notes
Handling an ambiguous date display without disturbing deterministic event order
Keeping a narrow settlement letter aligned with supplied legal authority
Maintaining exact factual agreement between the response letter and provenance annex

authoring_plan.scenario_intent: Create a narrow copyright-claim response package in which an editor reconstructs the final published provenance state from an opening inventory and subsequent production events, then communicates only the supplied counsel-approved position. The factual result is deterministic, while the solver must notice and disclose how the date presentation and corrective notes were handled.

content: A professional claim letter concerning one synthetic published episode, with a unique claim reference, claim date, response deadline, recipient details, asserted legal basis, requested amount, and a schedule of claimed footage intervals.
The schedule must identify each claimed interval with a stable claim-segment identifier, source timecodes, asserted duration, and claimant description.
The claimant aggregate must equal its listed interval durations. The claimed intervals must be capable of being partitioned exactly against the final published timeline in the provenance workbook.

The claim should overstate unlicensed use because it treats licensed footage, later replacements, public-domain footage, and the designated short quotation as claimant-owned unlicensed preview material.
constraints: Do not include instructions resolving the production log’s date or notes handling.
Use synthetic identifiers and contact details.

semantic_content: An opening-state inventory for the footage regions implicated by the claim, carrying stable segment or region identifiers, timeline in/out points, displayed source category, rights reference, publication status, and duration.

A set of ordered production events that modify the opening state through the final published master. Events must include replacements, trims, source or rights corrections, and final publication-status changes sufficient to produce final categories of unlicensed claimant preview, licensed claimant footage, the counsel-designated short quotation, Blackmarsh reshoots, and public-domain footage.
A stable event sequence or revision key must make the final event order deterministic even where a displayed date is ambiguous.

All claimed intervals must reconcile exactly to the final split intervals on a supplied frame-rate or time basis, without missing footage, duplicate records, formula errors, or contradictory authoritative events.
required_layout_defects_only: In one genuine date/time column, mix two representations: most entries use an unambiguous representation while at least one uses an ambiguous numeric day-month form. The event sequence key must independently preserve deterministic order.

Include a free-text notes column with several explicit per-row corrections that override displayed main-column values, such as correcting the final source category, publication status, applicable rights reference, or effective trim point. The correction language must be clear enough for a professional to recognize as controlling, but there must be no separate precedence rulebook.

Place a second, unrelated operational table beside the genuine production table on the same worksheet. One header in the unrelated table must contain an embedded line break. Its records must have no semantic relationship to the episode provenance.
prohibited_additional_defects: No hidden rows or columns carrying graded facts.
No merged-cell obstruction, shifted headers, banner-row trap, or inconsistent units beyond the required mixed date representation.
No facts needed for grading embedded only in images.

content: An episode-specific counsel-approved authority identifying the exact license agreement reference and the permitted use, term, territory or distribution scope that the response may assert.

The exact factual and legal position authorized for one short quotation under §107, including its segment identity and approved statements concerning purpose, contextual use, amount used, and market effect.

A fixed settlement amount, currency, offer-expiry date and time, acceptance method, payment trigger and timing, approved no-admission wording, episode-specific release terms, reservation-of-rights wording, response channel, and signature arrangement.
An approved controlled vocabulary for annex dispositions, with distinct labels for conceded preview material, licensed use, §107 position, Blackmarsh reshoot, and public-domain material.
A short instruction that the authority applies only to the identified episode and claim, without supplying any information about other episodes.
constraints: The authority must be commercially plausible and internally consistent with the claim and provenance records.
It may govern legal positions and settlement language because such an authority is a genuine workplace artifact, but it must not contain a purpose-built spreadsheet processing procedure.
All graded vocabulary and exact legal or commercial language the solver must emit must appear here.

state_replay_rules: Begin from each implicated timeline region’s opening-state source, rights, duration, and publication status.
Apply production events in stable event-sequence order through the final publication event.
An event changes only the fields and timeline region it addresses; unaffected fields persist from the prior state.
A replacement event substitutes the stated new source and rights basis for the affected region from its effective event onward.
A trim event changes the final in/out boundaries and duration on the supplied time basis.
An explicit corrective statement in the row’s notes controls over the inconsistent displayed main-field value for that row.
Only regions present in the final published master contribute to verified totals.
When one claimed interval crosses final-state provenance boundaries, divide it at those boundaries and assign each resulting duration to exactly one final category.
gold_derivation: Parse the claim schedule and calculate the claimant aggregate from the asserted durations.
Normalize production-event date displays for reporting, but use the stable event sequence to establish order so the ambiguous date cannot change the final result.
Replay all events against the opening inventory, applying the explicit corrective notes, to produce the final published interval state.
Intersect each claimed interval with final published intervals and split where provenance changes.
Map final source and rights states to the approved disposition vocabulary in Petra’s authority.
Compute mutually exclusive totals for conceded claimant preview material, licensed claimant footage, the designated §107 quotation, Blackmarsh reshoots, and public-domain material.
Verify that the final-category totals sum to the verified published total within one frame and that each claim interval is fully covered without overlap.
Generate a reference annex from the derived interval table and a reference letter using only the claim facts, replay-derived facts, and Petra’s approved language.

graded_relationships.claimant_total: Equals the sum of the claim schedule’s asserted interval durations.
graded_relationships.conceded_set: Equals final published intervals whose replayed provenance is Kilnbrook preview material and whose rights state is neither licensed nor the authorized §107 quotation.
graded_relationships.conceded_total: Equals the sum of final durations in the conceded set.
graded_relationships.licensed_set: Equals final published intervals whose replayed rights reference is the license identified in Petra’s authority and whose use is within its supplied scope.
graded_relationships.licensed_total: Equals the sum of final durations in the licensed set.
graded_relationships.section_107_result: Equals the one final published interval designated in Petra’s authority, retains its exact replay-derived duration, and is excluded from conceded duration.
graded_relationships.reshoot_set: Equals final published intervals whose controlling replacement or source record establishes Blackmarsh-originated reshoot material.
graded_relationships.public_domain_set: Equals final published intervals whose controlling source and rights record establishes the supplied public-domain basis.
graded_relationships.verified_total: Equals the sum of the five mutually exclusive final categories and the total covered final published duration corresponding to the claim intervals.
graded_relationships.cross_deliverable_agreement: Every shared segment identity, disposition, duration, aggregate, agreement reference, and settlement figure must be identical between the letter and annex, subject to one-frame duration tolerance and one-cent currency tolerance.

professional_review: Confirm that the letter concedes exactly the replay-derived unlicensed preview material without conceding licensed, §107, reshoot, or public-domain intervals.
Confirm that the letter asserts no legal ground or settlement term beyond Petra’s authority.
Confirm that the differences from the claimant snapshot are explained by material replacements, trims, or provenance corrections rather than unsupported argument.
Confirm that the package contains no statement extending an admission, offer, waiver, or release to another episode.
Confirm that the annex method note discloses use of event sequence for the ambiguous date and treatment of explicit corrective notes.
Confirm that the unrelated adjacent table is ignored.

original_instruction:
You are Damaris Almeida, the film and video editor at Blackmarsh Regional Office who conformed the published master of the episode identified in Kilnbrook Freight’s letter. Petra Havlicek has asked you to prepare the response package because the allegation turns on what was actually present in the published master, not simply what appeared in an earlier working bin. Callum Demirci will send your letter unchanged once Petra confirms that its factual statements and settlement terms match the authority already provided. Kilnbrook’s `Kilnbrook_claim_letter.docx` identifies the episode, the claimed footage intervals, its asserted aggregate duration, the rights position it says applies, the amount requested, and the response deadline. The production records are in `Blackmarsh_episode_provenance.xlsx`; they contain the opening segment status and the subsequent edit, replacement, trim, and rights events recorded by Ruben Mortensen and Odile Dalgaard through publication. Those records also include working notes made when a displayed status or source description needed correction, so read the record as an editor would rather than treating every visible main-field label as the last word. Petra’s approved legal and commercial boundaries are in `Petra_response_authority.docx`. That document is the only authority for the license position, the treatment of the short quotation under §107, the settlement amount and mechanics, the permitted disposition language, and the scope of any release or reservation of rights. Do not enlarge or soften those positions, offer alternatives, speculate about facts that are not in the attachments, or make a recommendation to Petra or Callum. I need a send-ready response letter saved as `Kilnbrook_episode_response.docx` and a supporting provenance annex saved as `Kilnbrook_provenance_annex.xlsx`. Write both files into the top level of the working directory you start in, using exactly those filenames. Address the letter as the claim directs and identify the claim and episode precisely enough that it cannot be mistaken for a response about a different production. The letter should acknowledge the asserted duration, state the duration and identity of the material Blackmarsh can properly concede after checking the published master, preserve the license position for footage covered by the agreement identified in Petra’s authority, maintain the authorized §107 position for the short quotation, and distinguish footage supported as Blackmarsh reshoots or public-domain material. It should explain, concisely and without recounting the entire editing history, the material reasons the verified published position differs from Kilnbrook’s account. Include the settlement terms, acceptance timing, payment mechanics, release boundary, reservation language, and response channel exactly as authorized. The aim is a narrow resolution of this episode’s claim, not correspondence about the wider production library. Keep the letter to two pages if ordinary business formatting permits, use a calm and precise professional tone, and leave it ready for Callum’s signature rather than writing it as an internal note or analysis. The annex is Petra’s traceable factual support for the letter. It should cover every footage interval listed in the claim and show, in a form counsel can filter and verify, the claim segment identifier, Kilnbrook’s asserted interval and duration, the corresponding final published timecode and duration, the final source or provenance category, the applicable rights basis, the final disposition using Petra’s approved vocabulary, and the supporting production record or event reference. Where an asserted interval resolves into more than one provenance result, make that division visible rather than assigning the whole interval to whichever category occupies the most time. Include a compact summary comparing Kilnbrook’s asserted total with the verified published totals for conceded preview material, licensed material, the §107 quotation, Blackmarsh reshoots, and public-domain material, and identify the material changes between the claim snapshot and the final published state. Add a short method note in the workbook that makes your treatment of the production record’s date presentation and any corrective per-entry notes clear enough for Petra to reproduce the result. The workbook should not reproduce unrelated operational information that happens to be displayed near the production records. The letter and annex must agree on every duration, category total, segment disposition, agreement reference, and settlement figure they share. Do not round footage in a way that changes a stated total; use a consistent time basis that can be followed from the individual intervals to the summaries. Both files must be clean, readable without specialist software beyond an ordinary word processor or spreadsheet application, and free of drafting comments, unresolved placeholders, formula errors, hidden assertions, or unsupported legal and factual claims. Petra needs the completed files in place by Friday so she can perform the final privilege and authority check before Callum sends the response.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/Kilnbrook_claim_letter.docx` — Kilnbrook Freight’s claim letter identifying the episode, claimed footage intervals, asserted duration, requested amount, claim reference, addressee, and response deadline.
- `references/Blackmarsh_episode_provenance.xlsx` — Blackmarsh Regional Office’s opening segment inventory and chronological production events through the published master, including source, timecode, duration, and corrective production notes.
- `references/Petra_response_authority.docx` — Petra Havlicek’s approved factual, legal, vocabulary, settlement, release, and signature parameters for this episode response.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `Kilnbrook_episode_response.docx` — A send-ready response letter resolving the identified episode claim within the supplied authority. (Place at the top level of the working directory. Use ordinary business-letter formatting, keep to two pages where ordinary formatting permits, and leave the letter ready for Callum Demirci’s signature.)
- `Kilnbrook_provenance_annex.xlsx` — A filterable provenance annex tracing every claimed footage interval to its verified final published status and summarizing the comparison. (Place at the top level of the working directory. Include the requested interval-level fields, category summary, comparison, and reproducible method note; exclude unrelated operational information.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
